decisions.reason: Margin analysis by location draws directly on the firm's core energy tariff data and regional analytics, so it can readily interpret early results and refine the product.
Gas tariff comparison by location reuses the same tariff database and geographic logic the firm already masters, giving high absorptive fit.
An electricity tariff calculator is likely the firm's core competence, and its dedicated page signals strategic importance and strong existing knowledge.
It overlaps heavily with the electricity and gas calculators and is only mentioned on the site, so it may be merged or relabelled, but the underlying knowledge base makes keeping it cheap.
A regional area definition tool is foundational infrastructure for all the firm's location-based products and builds on its geodata expertise.
Site-specific tariff comparison is only mentioned and overlaps with the other comparison tools, which raises consolidation risk, but it fits the firm's existing knowledge well.
